title: Auto load when filling the crate
problem: Filling the crate takes a tap for every piece.
scope: A button beside Open my stall that fills the crate with what is wanted: up to each fruit's wanted count, the oldest pieces a wanting customer takes, keeping what is already in the crate; greyed when nothing is left to add
exclusions: Any rule, balance, save or message change

acceptance.evidence: npm run verify on ac3d804: 841 tests passed, 1 skipped; lint, types and build passed.

npm run test:e2e on ac3d804 (08:47 to 09:00): solo game to the results, no errors; performance budget OK (longest task 193 ms against 200, 0.99 slow frames in 100 against 2); online match 80 pricing frames, 0 leaks, rematch, takeover; quick match; four people and two computers; reconnect 5 of 5.

acceptance.text: Tests: the oldest pieces a buyer takes, never more than wanted, what is in the crate stays, a second tap adds nothing; in whole games a crate the rules accept
acceptance.evidence: tests/rules12.test.ts: an Everyday buyer gets the fresh pieces and not the soft ones; a Bargain buyer the oldest first, up to what is wanted; what is in the crate stays; a second tap adds nothing; nothing goes out for a fruit nobody wants; the button greys out; in 12 whole computer games every auto-loaded crate is accepted by the rules, within the shelf, ripe, and no more than wanted (over 200 fruit checked).

Seen by me in played games: 4 stalls at 390x844 (before, pieces sliding in, loaded and greyed) and 6 and 4 stalls at 360x640; "Sell nothing today" now wraps to two lines beside the button instead of running out of it.
Pictures sent to the owner on 2026-11-13; he answered "push it live".

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-13, in his own words: "include an auto load button during crate unloading which allows players to unload all wanted fruits into the crate".

added: Auto load beside Open my stall: fills each wanted fruit up to its wanted count with the oldest pieces a buyer takes; greyed when nothing is left to add
changed: The main button's words may wrap to two lines beside it
